project.name: ANILOVE
project.title: A home for every next step.
project.description: A proposed route from the foundations to a thoughtful pet-adoption experience.
project.scope: Mobile-course prototype. Adoption and welfare cases are simulated.

current.label: Approved daily-use patch: local evidence and rollout/runtime gates
current.note: F42/F01/F03/F31 r2 + F29 r1 source integrated. Native/course/F39 gates and UI005 r3 review remain; no deployment.

branches.title: Platform & accounts
branches.description: The shared architecture, identity and offline foundation.

branches.title: Adoption journey
branches.description: The primary path from a pet listing to a confirmed handover.

branches.title: Trust & welfare
branches.description: Moderation, private follow-up, concerns and supported returns.

branches.title: Community
branches.description: Optional social, lost-pet and temporary-care experiences.

branches.title: Discovery & insights
branches.description: Finding the right pet, useful directories and operational insight.

groups.title: Platform foundation
groups.summary: Firestore, access rules, rotation and the technical boundaries.

groups.title: Accounts & privacy
groups.summary: A visitor becomes a member; personal information stays private.

groups.title: Pet listings
groups.summary: Identify the animal, disclose care needs and create a reviewable listing.

groups.title: Mobile moderation
groups.summary: A compact mobile review flow with reasons and protected decisions.

groups.title: Browse & discover
groups.summary: Approved public listings, bounded search, saved pets and sharing.

groups.title: Requests & matching
groups.summary: Suitability conversation, application, selection and private contact.

groups.title: Agreement & handover
groups.summary: Both parties accept the same terms and confirm the transfer.

groups.title: Offline experience
groups.summary: Previously viewed pages and drafts with honest synchronization states.

groups.title: Post-adoption care
groups.summary: Private updates, due tasks and durable notification records.

groups.title: Concerns & returns
groups.summary: Private review, help, appeals and safe simulated return scenarios.

groups.title: Factual reputation
groups.summary: Verified contact and participant reviews without a safety guarantee.

groups.title: Community stories
groups.summary: A moderated feed, likes, comments and pet-care news.

groups.title: Lost & found
groups.summary: Privacy-conscious notices and disputed ownership claims.

groups.title: Temporary care
groups.summary: A separate, time-bound care arrangement rather than adoption.

groups.title: Pet exchange
groups.summary: A complex optional branch involving two animals and partial transfers.

groups.title: Care reminders
groups.summary: User-entered care dates; reminders do not provide medical advice.

groups.title: Operational insights
groups.summary: Defined counts for handovers, open cases, returns and moderation.

nodes.title: Registration, login, logout, and Google sign-in
nodes.summary: Firebase Authentication, stable UID, explicit signed-in/visitor states, provider linking policy, and test accounts. Use Google sign-in as a proposed supporting API integration.

nodes.title: Password recovery and password changes
nodes.summary: provider-aware recovery and settings; recent reauthentication for sensitive operations; loading, expired-link, and failed-network states.

nodes.title: Profiles, contact details, and public visibility
nodes.summary: separate public name/avatar/general region/bio from private phone/contact settings; profile validation and a privacy preview.

nodes.title: Phone verification and trust badges
nodes.summary: explicit badge criteria, issue/revocation history, and distinction between "phone verified," "completed adoption," and "reviewed organization."

nodes.title: Admin access, account search, locks, and user CRUD
nodes.summary: protected Admin role, account lookup, reasons for restrictions, audit events, and a simple mobile account detail/action sheet.

nodes.title: Pet identity and claimed right to rehome
nodes.summary: petId separate from listingId, species/breed/sex/estimated age, identifying marks, and a Host declaration of ownership or rehoming authority. Microchip information, if used, is private and unverified by default.

nodes.title: Create, draft, edit, delete, hide, show, and close listings
nodes.summary: structured form, required/optional fields, local draft, saved server draft when online, preview, moderation version, and lifecycle actions.

analysis.approvalEvidence: Parent index records approval r2 on 2026-10-12; verify exact approval in context/analysis.

nodes.notes: Approved F07 r2 private slice implemented locally;41 JVM/92 emulator/build/lint/source audit checks pass. Device/course/cloud verification blocked; UI004 pending. Public/media/participant branches and R1 membership remain gated; no deployment.

nodes.title: Health, vaccination, sterilization, color, behavior, and care needs
nodes.summary: unknown/yes/no where appropriate, dated Host-supplied records, known behavior concerns, medication/care disclosures, and document redaction.

nodes.title: Photo upload, ordering, removal, and media access
nodes.summary: storage service, image compression, file/type/size limits, upload progress, retry, ordering, thumbnails, removal cleanup, and private/public separation.

nodes.title: Listing approval, rejection, and pet availability
nodes.summary: mobile review queue, specific reasons, revision history, and distinct availability actions.

nodes.title: Species, breed, and region catalogs
nodes.summary: stable category IDs, active/inactive status, species–breed relationship, and normalized regions; permit unknown/mixed breed.

nodes.title: Public grid, pet details, and Host information
nodes.summary: public listing projection, image grid, detail screen, loading/empty/error states, freshness indicator, and report access.

nodes.title: Search, filters, sorting, and pagination
nodes.summary: explicitly supported search semantics, species/region/age/sex/breed/type/status filters, indexes, stable ordering, cursor pagination, and reset when filters change.

nodes.title: Save/unsave favorites
nodes.summary: member-owned favorites keyed by user and listing; detail links and private list.

nodes.title: Share links, Facebook, and Zalo
nodes.summary: OS share sheet, public listing URL and routing policy, fallback when target app is absent, and friendly unavailable content.

nodes.title: Adoption suitability questionnaire
nodes.summary: short pet-relevant questions, explanation of purpose/access, required versus optional answers, and a way to ask for clarification.

nodes.title: Submit, view, withdraw, and cancel adoption applications
nodes.summary: application ID, applicant/listing IDs, approved listing snapshot/version, message, questionnaire, status, timestamps, and history.

nodes.title: Host review, accept/reject, and reservation
nodes.summary: private applicant list/detail, comparison against pet needs, decision reason, atomic selection/reservation, and expiry/cancellation policy.

nodes.title: Phone/Zalo contact and in-app chat
nodes.summary: participant-only contact access after selection; if chat is included, conversation membership, message history, blocking/reporting, attachment limits, and notifications.

nodes.title: Meeting, readiness checklist, and agreement acceptance
nodes.summary: mutually acknowledged meeting plan, pet-needs checklist, versioned simulated terms, acceptance records, and cancellation/revision actions.

nodes.title: Confirm handover and close competing requests
nodes.summary: two separate confirmations, handover snapshot, authoritative completion event, and exactly one follow-up plan.

nodes.title: Adoption and exchange history
nodes.summary: member-scoped history, roles for each event, status/date filters, accepted snapshots, and returns/cancellations distinguished from successful handovers.

nodes.title: Private post-adoption updates for 90 days
nodes.summary: plan with six task dates, structured care/support answers, recent photos on later tasks, revision history, received time, and access policy agreed before handover.

nodes.title: Follow-up reminders, lateness, and extensions
nodes.summary: authoritative deadlines, in-app due/overdue state, retryable reminder events, explicit extensions, and assigned review tasks.

nodes.title: Welfare concerns, evidence, and urgent case triage
nodes.summary: private case tied to pet/adoption, allegation text, optional evidence, urgency, reporter protection, reviewer assignment, response record, and outcome reasons.

nodes.title: Voluntary return, disputed recovery, and relisting
nodes.summary: adopter help/return request, Host concern/request, destination suitability review, transfer agreement, two confirmations, interim-care record, and custody history.

nodes.title: Appeals, restrictions, and sensitive-case decisions
nodes.summary: reasoned decisions, member notice, appeal route, reassignment, evidence access log, restriction expiry/review, and preserved support access.

nodes.title: Reviews and ratings after adoption/exchange
nodes.summary: one review per party per confirmed handover, limited edit window, moderation/reporting, and clear rating criteria.

nodes.title: General reporting of listings, posts, comments, and accounts
nodes.summary: target type/ID, category, reason, optional evidence, reporter ID/access, status, Admin resolution, and duplicate handling.

nodes.title: Push notifications, in-app inbox, and read status
nodes.summary: durable in-app event/inbox records, device tokens per account/device, permissions, delivery retries where appropriate, deep-link authorization, and recipient-owned read status.

nodes.title: Community feed, personal posts, likes, comments, and news
nodes.summary: explicit post type, author, text/media, visibility, moderation, pagination, reaction uniqueness, comment lifecycle, and report actions. Admin news uses the same controlled publishing model with its own authoring permissions.

analysis.approvalEvidence: Parent index records approval r2 on 2026-10-13; verify exact approval in context/analysis.

nodes.notes: Accepted daily-use source patch;57 JVM/134 emulator/debug/test APK/source audits pass. Required native/course/release binding/F39 rollout gates; UI005 r3 review pending. No deployment/full public milestone. See DAILY_USE.r1 report.

nodes.title: Lost and found pets
nodes.summary: lost/found types, approximate area/time, photos, private proof-of-ownership questions, claim workflow, and resolved/expired states.

nodes.title: Temporary care/fostering while away
nodes.summary: explicit nonpermanent custody, date range, care instructions, medications, supplies/cost policy, emergency contact, both-party intake and return confirmation.

nodes.title: Pet exchange
nodes.summary: definition of exchange, two pet IDs, two care disclosures, two suitability decisions, linked agreement, and a four-sided confirmation model covering each member's relinquishment and receipt.

nodes.title: GPS, nearby pets, and vet/pet-shop maps
nodes.summary: location permission, approximate location option, directory/maps provider, API credential restrictions, place freshness, distance calculation, and no-permission fallback.

nodes.title: Vaccination and deworming reminders
nodes.summary: user/vet-entered due dates, pet association, timezone, edit/cancel/snooze, and notification settings.

nodes.title: Personalized pet recommendations
nodes.summary: stated input signals, member opt-out/reset, an explainable ranking, and data minimization.

nodes.title: Vietnamese/English, dark mode, accessibility, and rotation
nodes.summary: resource-based strings, date formats, contrast-aware themes, scalable text, screen-reader labels, responsive layout, preserved navigation/form state, and keyboard handling.

nodes.title: Mobile Admin content and case tools
nodes.summary: compact queues for listings, reports, welfare/return cases, and community/news where enabled; detail/decision screens, reason fields, revision checks, and action history.

nodes.title: Dashboard and statistics
nodes.summary: definitions for users, pets, listings, pending review, available/reserved/placed pets, requests, confirmed handovers, reports, active cases, and returns; reporting time window and aggregation method.

nodes.title: SQLite cache, offline viewing, drafts, and synchronization
nodes.summary: explicit division between Firestore authority, SQLite views/drafts, and image-file cache; record versions, lastFetchedAt, account-scoped private data, logout cleanup, and reconnect policy.

nodes.title: Firebase services, trusted operations, cost, and security
nodes.summary: Firestore as required by course, Auth, media storage choice, protected roles, Firestore/Storage rules, trusted execution for scheduled/privileged work, bounded queries/uploads, and separate demo configuration.

nodes.title: Account deletion, retention, and private evidence
nodes.summary: record-class retention policy, deletion request/status, public removal, dependency checks, media/local-cache cleanup, anonymization rules, and clear separation between personal data and historical events.

nodes.title: Support, care guidance, and prototype boundaries
nodes.summary: easy help entry points, adoption-care checklist, report/return explanations, visible simulated status, demo contacts, and clear non-emergency scope.
